results.label: yes
results.reason: elections_process/state: Voter list revision issues in Tamil Nadu

notes.subject: polity
notes.why_in_news: Tamil Nadu's Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process for voter list is facing issues, risking the deletion of genuine voters ahead of next year's elections.
notes.fact_box: The Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process in Tamil Nadu is facing significant issues, including unrealistic deadlines, confusing forms, and missing instructions. This process risks deleting the names of lakhs of genuine voters ahead of the next year's elections.

prelims_pointers.text: Special Intensive Revision (SIR) is a process under the Representation of the People Act, 1951.
Lakhs of genuine voters are at risk of being deleted from the voter list.
Election Commission of India is overseeing the SIR process.

notes.mains_question: Examine the challenges faced during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process in Tamil Nadu and suggest ways to ensure the accuracy and integrity of the voter list.

results.title: EC tells Supreme Court Centre’s citizenship scrutiny powers are limited - The Hindu
results.label: yes
results.reason: constitutional_authority/national: Election Commission clarifies citizenship scrutiny powers

notes.subject: polity
notes.why_in_news: Election Commission of India dismissed arguments by opposition parties that only the Centre has exclusive authority to scrutinise citizenship, asserting its own jurisdiction.
notes.fact_box: The Election Commission of India argued that its powers to scrutinise citizenship are limited to determining when or how an Indian citizen acquired foreign citizenship. This is based on Section 9 of the Citizenship Act, 1955. The EC also asserted its authority under Article 324 and 326 of the Constitution.

prelims_pointers.text: Article 324 empowers the Election Commission to supervise and control the conduct of elections.
Article 326 requires Indian citizenship as a constitutional precondition for entry into the voter list.
Section 9 of the Citizenship Act, 1955, vests the Centre with the authority to determine when or how an Indian citizen acquired foreign citizenship.

notes.mains_question: Examine the jurisdiction of the Election Commission in scrutinising citizenship and its alignment with constitutional provisions.
